scenario: checking an important detail about neighbourhood & directions
english_title: Recognising and Responding to Checking an Important Detail About Neighbourhood and Directions
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: neighbourhood & directions — checking an important detail about neighbourhood & directions
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to checking an important detail about neighbourhood & directions; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Mr Michael if the market is open on Sunday.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan hỏi anh Michael chợ có mở cửa vào Chủ nhật không.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, Michael. Is the market open on Sunday?
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi anh Michael. Chợ có mở cửa vào Chủ nhật không?

turns.speaker: Mr Michael
turns.english: Yes, it is open every day.
turns.vietnamese: Có, chợ mở cửa mỗi ngày.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.vietnamese: Biết vậy tốt quá, cảm ơn anh.
